scope: Owner-approved performance audit validation and implementation across engine, CLI and macOS client

recommendations.change: Indexed live queues and ownership independent of retained history, paged resource inspection and compact scalar status.
Shared fresh asynchronous process census, indexed ancestry, exact signal checks and finite retry of a failed snapshot.
Bounded worker pool for large hashes, extraction, app copying, history inventories, backup verification and storage traversal; final authority stays with service.
Negotiated persistent owned peer helper, finite four-chunk windows, control fairness, legacy fallback and generated canonical validators.
Indexed retention and fresh complete off-thread storage admission. Producer-only cached usage was rejected because unknown files must count.
Event-driven native refresh, targeted selected details, compact activity projections, bounded log cursors and inactive polling.
Due-deadline GitHub polling with two concurrent repositories, coalescing and preserved retry/destination policy.

investigation: SQLite initially chose the namespace history index for a global live query; actual-plan proof and explicit sparse index selection repaired it. Missing-state records remain included and fenced.
Asynchronous storage admission exposed concurrent native repair selection; the uniqueness guard now runs in synchronous admission after the await.

An unavailable process snapshot had permanently poisoned later positive release evidence. Fresh complete disappearance can now confirm release; one retry stays within the original deadline. Persistent outage, malformed or empty observations and failed durable callbacks never grant release authority.
Two earlier complete runs were stopped after reproduced failures. Interrupted tests are not counted as passed; the final complete run is recorded separately.
App-copy permission changes now use retained file and directory descriptors; a replacement-path fixture preserves a foreign target.

CLI after parsing originally coerced UUID resource cursors to numbers. The final command-aware parser preserves UUIDs and rejects invalid resource cursors while numeric event cursors remain supported.
Obsolete generated CLI index output from the merged retirement was removed after verifying that its source was absent.
proofLimits: Synthetic timings are local samples, not production latency guarantees.
Injected peer latency excludes real SSH, network and receiver fsync costs.
Installed macOS interaction, live two-host compatibility and physical devices were not qualified.
No installation, enrollment, push or hardware change was performed.
The full 504-test run predates only the final cursor correction; the final source passed its affected 20 tests and build. Focused runs overlap and are not summed.
worktree: Native artifact inventory contains no archival attachment; the checkout remains intact.

measurements.method: Warm medians: five ordinary samples, nine cold-launch samples and three filesystem census samples. Responsiveness, process and transfer probes are single samples. Baseline and final samples use their respective lockfiles.
